anomaly_alerts.title: How these numbers are counted
anomaly_alerts.description: Read as SaaS subscription data (MRR, ARR, paying customers, new MRR, churned MRR, logo churn, net revenue retention, gross revenue retention). MRR is the monthly run-rate of the customers paying at the latest date (an annual plan ÷ 12, net of discounts; trials, paused and unpaid subscriptions out, past due in), not revenue; movements and retention compare each customer's MRR at month-ends over the 12 months to that date, and annual churn is measured on the customers paying 12 months earlier, never a monthly rate × 12. A customer who starts and leaves inside one month appears in no month-end figure. The churned column is a flag, not a dated event: the share of rows flagged is not a churn rate.

executive_view.headline: 200 customers generating $40,308.46 MRR and $483,701.52 ARR as of 31 Oct 2026, with net revenue retention at 106.5% but down from 122.7% a year earlier.

paragraphs.text: The dataset covers 200 active SaaS customers across 30 months (May 2024 to Oct 2026), with no logo churn and MRR growth driven entirely by expansion from existing customers.

findings.text: No customers churned in the 12-month window to 31 Oct 2026 — logo churn is 0.0% for both the current and prior cohort — and all 200 customers active a year ago remain in force today.

Net revenue retention for the 12-month cohort to 31 Oct 2026 is 106.5%, compared with 122.7% for the cohort to 31 Oct 2025, a decline of 16.2 points; gross revenue retention moved from 100.0% to 99.3% over the same comparison.

Monthly recurring revenue peaked at $43,813.56 in Sep 2026 and fell to $40,308.46 by 31 Oct 2026; the 12-month MRR bridge shows $16,056.28 in expansion MRR offset by $13,587.47 in contraction MRR, with no new or churned MRR.
Average monthly recurring revenue varies widely by plan: Enterprise averages $860.39, Pro averages $173.36, and Basic averages $57.97, with individual customer MRR ranging from $35.44 to $1,023.37.
Average monthly recurring revenue: Enterprise (860.39) is higher than Basic (57.97).

caveats: Monthly recurring revenue is a run-rate snapshot, not recognised revenue; movements reflect month-end positions only, so a customer who starts and leaves within one month does not appear in any figure.
The support tickets column has flagged outliers that were kept; any analysis involving support tickets should be interpreted with care until those values are validated.
There is no new or reactivation MRR in the 12-month window, which may reflect the customer base being fully mature or a data characteristic worth confirming with the source system.
3 sentence(s) stating a cause or grading a result against a norm were removed: this data shows neither a controlled test nor an outside benchmark.
